QuestInfo.name: [Silent Crusade] The Hunter
QuestInfo.0: #p9073015# received a strange message. Ask about it.
QuestInfo.1: According to #p9073015#, the message originated from #r#m270010110##k. You'll have to travel there if you want to find out more.
QuestInfo.2: Whoa! This is a surprise. The message was sent by #p9073024#, a Supply Merchant!
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 833,346\r\nCan proceed to '[Silent Crusade] The Flying Whale' quest\r\n

0.0: Ugh! This message is impossible to decipher! \r\n#L0##bWell, what've you figured out so far?#l\n#k
0.1: Not much. Just that this message is almost definitely from within the Silent Crusade and that the message came from #r#m270010110##k. You willing to go check it out?

yes.0: Thank you. Maybe you can shed some light on this message if you head over to #r#m270010110##k.

no.0: But there's nobody else to send...

1.0: ...\r\n#L0##b(It's the merchant from the #m931050500#. What's he doing here?)#l\n#k
1.1: Ah, ha! I'm a little surprised someone actually responded to my message, especially when I know #p9073005# has already been sent on another mission. \r\n#L0##bThe message was from you? What's going on? What are you doing here?#l\n#k
1.2: Watch your tone, rookie... I'm here because I have a job to do. And I sent the message, because I need assistance to complete my job.

yes.0: And I happen to think you're PERFECT for the role.

npc.0: Maybe you can shed some light on the strange message if you head over to #r#m270010110##k.
